metadata.name: Aerosol Chemical Composition and Spatial Data
metadata.description: This dataset contains information about aerosol samples, including event details, sample IDs, stages, aerosol size ranges, dates/times, geographical coordinates, height, and various chemical concentrations such as Cl-, [NO3]-, [SO4]2-, [C2O4]2-, [NO2]-, Br-, F-, MSA, [PO4]3-, Na+, [NH4]+, K+, and Mg2+. The data covers a period from May 24, 2017, to July 16, 2017, with samples collected across a wide range of latitudes and longitudes.
